channel.title: Agri & fertilisers · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: mixed (+0.5).

item.title: [−3] Rajasthan records rainfall deficit of over 20%, worst in 16 years
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 3 reports from The New Indian Express, Business Standard, Investment Guru India. Related: “October downpour wipes out TN’s 16 per cent rainfall deficit”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 23 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: strong headwind (−3) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] EU chief confirms PM Modi’s December visit to sign India-EU trade deal
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 47 reports from Business Standard, Reuters, The New Indian Express and 34 more. Related: “US trade deal to give India strong comparative advantage, says Piyush Goyal”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 23 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Onion prices surge 108% as food inflation bites harder in rural India
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian food prices (India). 2 reports from Firstpost, Business Today. Related: “Food inflation surges to 7.74%, oil shock threatens India’s growth momentum”. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Better farm-gate prices

Why it matters: Food carries a large weight in India's CPI, so rising food prices squeeze household budgets and limit the RBI's room to cut rates.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −3, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
